route_statement: This is a DIFFERENT route from the prior D_k growth-rate claim: it compares nested first-order Markov and i.i.d. models, and a positive result here does NOT restore, confirm, or rescue any prior SUBLINEAR verdict.

models.observable: Binary direction sequence X_1,...,X_30 from the cached first 30 PPI direction bits; flows are selected by PPI_LEN >= 30.
models.iid_model: X_t are independent Bernoulli(p) for all t, with one fitted parameter p.
models.first_order_markov_model: X_1 ~ Bernoulli(pi), and X_t | X_{t-1}=r ~ Bernoulli(theta_r) for r in {0,1} and t>=2, with three fitted parameters (pi, theta_0, theta_1).
models.nested_constraint: IID is the Markov submodel pi = theta_0 = theta_1 = p.
models.fit: Exact maximum likelihood from initial-state and transition counts; no smoothing.
models.criterion: BIC = -2 log(L) + d log(N), where N is the number of observed direction bits at the tested prefix length and d is the model parameter count.
models.comparison: Delta_BIC = BIC_IID - BIC_Markov; Delta_BIC > 0 favours Markov, Delta_BIC < 0 favours IID, and zero is a tie.
models.pre_registered_scope: Per-service at k=30 and per-service at every prefix length k=2..30; no aggregate-only verdict.
models.pre_registered_control_gate: USABLE iff the synthetic IID case has a strict majority of items not favouring Markov with median Delta_BIC <= 0, and the synthetic dependent case has a strict majority favouring Markov with median Delta_BIC > 0.
models.parameter_count_asymmetry: Markov has two more free parameters than IID; the BIC penalty is included in every reported comparison and raw likelihood advantage is not reported as a result.

decision_rule.iid_case: strict majority of items must not favour Markov and median Delta_BIC must be <= 0
decision_rule.dependent_case: strict majority of items must favour Markov and median Delta_BIC must be > 0
decision_rule.control_outcome: USABLE iff both case rules hold

real_data_comparison.observable: first 30 PPI direction bits for every cached flow with PPI_LEN >= 30

if_not_usable: Not applicable: the known-truth control was usable.

cost_estimate.basis: cached merged.pkl only; no H5 read
cost_estimate.model_fits_after_control: service_count * 29 prefix lengths, plus one final k=30 report per service
